description: Opens an unterminated block comment near the top of a 100,000-line file, then closes it again. Every following line's start state changes until the comment is closed by the next '*/' already in the file, at which point the state reconverges and the rest of the document is reused. This is the trace that shows reconvergence bounding the damage of a state-changing edit; raw-string-runaway is the case where it cannot.
budget: relex extent for a state-changing edit that reconverges
